name: VOW temporary usdRate exposure
summary: A scheduled rate-setting transaction changed the effective VOW-to-vUSD conversion from [5,1] to [1,100]. Twenty-four seconds later, the attacker flash-borrowed VOW, sent it through the permissionless VSCTokenManager receive path, minted 148.66 million vUSD, and traded it against VOW liquidity pools.
notes: VOWToken.setUSDRate changed usdRate from [5,1] to [1,100], and VSCTokenManager.getVOWVSCRate() reproduced the effective conversion change across the block.

The exploit sends exactly 175.477781952968920940 ETH, 595,970.517680 USDT, and 5,801,632.714644004917570378 VOW to the attacker EOA after repaying the flash-borrowed VOW. The Chainlink ETH/USD feed returned $2,636.5146, and USDT is valued at par. VOW is left unpriced because the exploit itself consumed its liquidity, so the USD total is a floor.
The USD total excludes the retained VOW because the exploit consumed its available liquidity.
